intro: A pristine Crystal Phial entrusted to young night elf adventurers by the druid Tenaron Stormgrip in Shadowglen. It is used to draw sacred water from a nearby moonwell, beginning a series of rites meant to honor and nourish the growing World Tree, Teldrassil.

p: Given to novice night elves atop Aldrassil, this delicate glass phial serves a vital ceremonial purpose. Tenaron Stormgrip tasks young protectors with carrying it to the moonwell just north of the bough to collect its glowing waters. While simple in construction, the phial holds water infused with the sacred legacy of the Well of Eternity. Bringing back a Filled Crystal Phial marks the first step of the Crown of the Earth pilgrimage, teaching young kaldorei the precarious balance of magic, history, and nature in their new island home.
